title: Training Language Models to Self-Correct via Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Aviral Kumar、Vincent Zhuang、Rishabh Agarwal、Yi Su、John D Co-Reyes、Avi Singh、Kate Baumli、Shariq Iqbal、Colton Bishop、Rebecca Roelofs、Lei M Zhang、Kay McKinney、Disha Shrivastava、Cosmin Paduraru、George Tucker、Doina Precup、Feryal Behbahani、Aleksandra Faust
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: SCoRe trains on the learner's own two-turn correction episodes, using a KL-constrained initialization followed by progress-shaped multi-turn RL with programmatic outcome rewards.
SCoRe 在学习者自身的两轮纠正轨迹上训练，先做 KL 约束的初始化，再用进度整形的多轮强化学习配合程序化结果奖励。
why: It makes the collection-policy mismatch and correction-collapse problems explicit and gives this track a concrete schema for on-policy attempts, per-turn rewards, and sequential test-time traces.
inclusion_reason: SCoRe defines an auditable two-turn on-policy correction episode whose terminal programmatic rewards, Stage I distribution constraint, and Stage II progress bonus directly connect online trace collection to RLVR and test-time sequential sampling.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Intrinsic self-correction asks one model to inspect and revise its own first response without receiving an oracle critique at test time. The paper shows two data-and-optimization failures. Offline SFT learns from correction traces produced by an earlier collection policy, so the trained model may face a different distribution of first-turn errors. SFT and naive multi-turn RL can also collapse toward producing a stronger first answer followed by superficial or no change, rather than learning when and how to revise.

SCoRe studies this problem on math and code. Its central data object is not a static answer pair but an online two-turn episode: problem, first attempt, generic self-correction instruction, second attempt, and a binary outcome reward for each attempt. This belongs in Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because the policy that is being trained also generates the attempts, and the same sequential attempt structure is later evaluated as test-time compute. The paper does not release a reusable trace corpus, so the card records the recipe and audit boundary rather than claiming a data release.

内在自我纠错要求同一模型在测试时不接收 oracle critique，仅检查并修订自己的第一次回答。论文指出两类与数据和优化相关的失败。离线 SFT 学习的是早期收集策略生成的纠错轨迹，因此训练后模型面对的首轮错误分布可能已经不同。SFT 和朴素多轮 RL 还可能坍塌为“第一轮尽量答好、第二轮只做表面修改或完全不改”，而没有学会何时以及如何修订。

SCoRe 在数学和代码任务上研究这一问题。其核心数据对象不是静态 answer pair，而是在线两轮 episode：题目、第一次作答、通用自我纠错指令、第二次作答，以及两次作答各自的二元结果奖励。它属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为被训练的策略同时生成这些尝试，而且同样的顺序作答结构还被用于测试时计算评估。论文没有发布可复用的轨迹语料，因此本卡记录构造配方和审计边界，不把它写成数据发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SCoRe trains on the learner's own two-turn correction episodes instead of fitting a fixed offline repair corpus. At test time, the second attempt sees the first response and a generic instruction to check for an error and rewrite if needed; it does not see the oracle reward, correctness label, or test outcome.

Training has two distinct stages. Stage I creates a non-collapsed initialization: it optimizes reward on the second attempt while using a KL penalty to keep the first-turn distribution close to the base model. Stage II jointly optimizes both attempts and shapes the second-turn reward with alpha * (r2 - r1). The bonus is positive for wrong-to-right transitions, negative for right-to-wrong transitions, and zero when correctness does not change; the reported alpha is 10.

The feedback contract is programmatic and terminal. MATH responses receive a binary reward from ground-truth answer matching, and code receives a binary reward only if all tests pass. These signals label answer outcomes, not intermediate reasoning steps. The online trace plus its two rewards is therefore the reusable conceptual object; reported benchmark accuracy is evidence about the trained policy under the tested setup, not proof that every sampled trace is reliable.

SCoRe 不拟合固定的离线修复语料，而是在学习者自身生成的两轮纠错 episode 上训练。测试时，第二次作答会看到第一次回答和一条通用指令，要求检查错误并在必要时重写；它看不到 oracle reward、正确性标签或测试结果。

训练包含两个明确分开的阶段。Stage I 构造不易坍塌的初始化：优化第二次作答的奖励，同时用 KL penalty 约束第一轮分布接近基座模型。Stage II 联合优化两次作答，并用 alpha * (r2 - r1) 塑形第二轮奖励。第一次错误而第二次正确时 bonus 为正，第一次正确而第二次错误时为负，正确性不变时为零；论文报告的 alpha 为 10。

反馈契约是程序化的终局信号。MATH 回答通过与 ground-truth answer 匹配得到二元奖励，代码只有通过全部测试才得到二元奖励。这些信号标记回答结果，不标记中间推理步骤。因此，可复用的概念对象是在线轨迹及其两轮奖励；论文报告的 benchmark accuracy 只支持所测设置中的训练策略效果，不能证明每条采样轨迹都可靠。

title: Method
方法
html:
For math, training uses MATH train augmented with 4,500 problems from the original MATH test set, while the remaining 500 form MATH500 evaluation. Code training uses MBPP and evaluation uses HumanEval; MBPP-R is also used as an offline repair evaluation. Gemini 1.5 Flash is fine-tuned for MATH and Gemini 1.0 Pro for code. The second-turn prompt is fixed and does not reveal whether the first answer is correct.

Each online episode samples a first attempt from the current policy, appends the self-correction instruction, and samples a second attempt conditioned on the full history. The verifier computes r1 and r2: MATH uses binary ground-truth answer matching and code uses whether all tests pass. Stage I optimizes second-turn reward while penalizing KL divergence of the first-turn policy from the base model. Stage II jointly applies REINFORCE-style updates to both turns, with KL regularization and a shaped second-turn reward containing alpha * (r2 - r1). The paper also notes that some experiments add repeatedly sampled base-model first attempts as offline prompts to increase state coverage.

Reported MATH hyperparameters are Adam, learning rate 5e-6, 3,000 steps, batch size 512, sampling temperature 1.0, alpha 10, beta1 0.01, and beta2 0.1. MBPP uses learning rate 1e-5, 1,500 steps, batch size 128, temperature 1.0, alpha 10, beta1 0.01, and beta2 0.25. Evaluation is greedy except inference-compute scaling, which uses temperature 0.7. RL checkpoints are selected by highest training reward. The number of rollouts per prompt, random seeds, exact split manifest, answer-extraction implementation, and test harness are not fully disclosed in a released executable artifact.

数学训练使用 MATH train，并加入原 MATH test set 中的 4,500 道题；剩余 500 道构成 MATH500 评估。代码训练使用 MBPP，评估使用 HumanEval；MBPP-R 还用于离线修复评估。MATH 微调 Gemini 1.5 Flash，代码微调 Gemini 1.0 Pro。第二轮 prompt 固定，而且不会透露第一次回答是否正确。

每个在线 episode 先从当前策略采样第一次作答，再拼接自我纠错指令，并基于完整历史采样第二次作答。Verifier 计算 r1 和 r2：MATH 使用 ground-truth answer 二元匹配，代码使用是否通过全部测试。Stage I 优化第二轮奖励，同时惩罚第一轮策略相对基座模型的 KL divergence。Stage II 对两轮联合进行 REINFORCE 风格更新，保留 KL regularization，并在第二轮塑形奖励中加入 alpha * (r2 - r1)。论文还说明，部分实验会把反复采样得到的基座模型第一轮解答作为离线 prompt 加入，以扩大状态覆盖。

论文报告的 MATH 超参数为 Adam、学习率 5e-6、3,000 步、batch size 512、采样温度 1.0、alpha 10、beta1 0.01、beta2 0.1。MBPP 使用学习率 1e-5、1,500 步、batch size 128、温度 1.0、alpha 10、beta1 0.01、beta2 0.25。除测试时计算扩展使用温度 0.7 外，评估采用 greedy decoding。RL checkpoint 按最高训练奖励选择。每题 rollout 数、随机种子、精确 split manifest、答案抽取实现和测试 harness 没有通过已发布的可执行 artifact 完整披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates first-turn accuracy, second-turn accuracy, the net change between turns, wrong-to-right transitions, and right-to-wrong regressions. On MATH, the reported SCoRe model reaches 60.0% on the first attempt and 64.4% on the second, a 4.4-point within-model delta. On HumanEval, it reports 52.4% and 64.6%, a 12.2-point delta. These are results for the reported Gemini models and task splits, not estimates of the intrinsic quality of an exported dataset.

The ablation table supports the role of both stages in the tested MATH setup: removing Stage I reduces the reported second-minus-first delta from 4.4 to 2.2 points, and removing reward shaping reduces it to 2.6 points. The paper's analysis of offline SFT also shows that correction performance can improve on fixed base-model first attempts while degrading on first attempts sampled from the learner, which supports the collection-policy mismatch diagnosis.

For inference scaling, the paper compares equal total sample budgets and reports that K parallel samples followed by one correction each can outperform 2K independent parallel samples in its setting. This supports sequential use of the learned policy under the evaluated budget; it does not establish a universal compute advantage, verifier reliability, or trace-data quality.

论文评估第一次作答准确率、第二次作答准确率、两轮净变化、错误到正确的转移，以及正确到错误的退化。在 MATH 上，报告的 SCoRe 模型第一次作答为 60.0%，第二次为 64.4%，同一模型的轮间增量为 4.4 个百分点。在 HumanEval 上，报告值为 52.4% 和 64.6%，增量为 12.2 个百分点。这些是特定 Gemini 模型和任务划分上的结果，不是对某个已导出数据集内在质量的估计。

消融表支持两个阶段在所测 MATH 设置中的作用：移除 Stage I 后，报告的第二轮减第一轮增量从 4.4 降至 2.2 个百分点；移除 reward shaping 后降至 2.6 个百分点。论文对离线 SFT 的分析还显示，模型在固定的基座模型首轮回答上纠错能力可能上升，但在学习者自身采样的首轮回答上反而下降，这支持 collection-policy mismatch 的诊断。

在推理扩展实验中，论文比较相同总采样预算，并报告在其设置下，先并行采样 K 次再分别纠错一次，可能优于 2K 次相互独立的并行采样。这支持所评估预算下对已训练策略进行顺序使用，但不能证明普遍的计算优势、verifier 可靠性或轨迹数据质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier intrinsic-correction methods commonly use prompting, a separate refiner or teacher, or SFT on offline before/after traces. SCoRe changes the construction distribution and the objective together: the learner generates its own first and second attempts online, Stage I deliberately holds the first-turn policy near the base distribution while improving the second turn, and Stage II rewards changes in correctness in addition to terminal performance.

The direction signal for this atlas is the separation between collecting a plausible repair pair and training a policy that can repair its own current errors. The progress bonus also distinguishes wrong-to-right correction from a policy that merely raises first-turn accuracy and then leaves the answer unchanged. This makes policy checkpoint, training stage, both outcome rewards, and sampling metadata necessary lineage fields for an auditable trace.

SCoRe does not introduce process-level verification, a public correction dataset, or an oracle-free training reward. Ground-truth answers and unit tests still define training correctness, and REINFORCE with KL regularization is existing machinery. The contribution is the two-stage organization and reward shaping for on-policy intrinsic correction.

早期内在纠错方法通常依赖 prompting、独立 refiner 或 teacher，或者在离线修改前后轨迹上做 SFT。SCoRe 同时改变构造分布和优化目标：学习者在线生成自己的第一次与第二次作答；Stage I 在提高第二轮的同时，刻意让第一轮策略保持接近基座分布；Stage II 除终局表现外，还奖励正确性的跨轮变化。

对本图谱而言，方向信号在于区分“收集看似合理的 repair pair”和“训练能修复自身当前错误的策略”。Progress bonus 还把错误到正确的纠错，与仅提高第一轮准确率后保持答案不变的策略区分开。因此，要审计这类轨迹，必须保留 policy checkpoint、训练阶段、两轮结果奖励和采样元数据。

SCoRe 没有提出过程级验证、公开纠错数据集或无需 oracle 的训练奖励。Ground-truth answer 和单元测试仍然定义训练正确性，带 KL regularization 的 REINFORCE 也是已有机制。其贡献是面向 on-policy 内在纠错的两阶段组织和 reward shaping。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The study is limited to one correction step on math and code with binary outcome rewards. Transfer to open-ended tasks requiring human judgment, longer correction chains, interactive environments, or non-binary process feedback is unknown. An answer can receive terminal credit despite flawed reasoning, while an answer extractor or incomplete unit-test suite can reject valid outputs or accept wrong ones.

The MATH protocol moves 4,500 original test problems into training and evaluates on the remaining MATH500. Comparisons must preserve that paper-specific split and must not read the score as performance on the untouched original test set. Checkpoint selection uses training reward, so reward implementation details are part of the evaluation lineage.

No official reusable code repository, raw online trajectory corpus, trained checkpoint, exact split manifest, seed list, run log, artifact license, or decontamination report was confirmed. The paper provides prompts and major hyperparameters but does not disclose per-prompt rollout count in the table. Therefore reproduction can implement the stated objective, but exact replay and independent trace-level audit remain blocked.

研究只覆盖数学和代码任务中的一次纠错，并使用二元结果奖励。向需要人工判断的开放任务、更长纠错链、交互环境或非二元过程反馈迁移的效果仍为 unknown。即使中间推理有缺陷，回答也可能获得终局奖励；答案抽取器或不完整单元测试还可能拒绝有效输出或接受错误输出。

MATH 协议把原 test set 中的 4,500 道题移入训练，只在剩余 MATH500 上评估。比较时必须保留这一论文特定划分，不能把分数解读为在未经改动的原始 test set 上的表现。Checkpoint 按训练奖励选择，因此奖励实现细节也是评估 lineage 的一部分。

未确认发布官方可复用代码库、原始在线轨迹语料、训练 checkpoint、精确 split manifest、随机种子列表、运行日志、artifact license 或 decontamination report。论文给出 prompt 和主要超参数，但表中没有披露每题 rollout 数。因此可以按论文实现目标函数，但精确回放和独立的轨迹级审计仍然受阻。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, SCoRe supplies a concrete schema for a sequential correction record: task and split identity, policy checkpoint, training stage, first attempt, correction instruction, second attempt, extracted answers, r1, r2, progress bonus, KL reference, sampling parameters, and terminal checker result. Retaining only the second answer would erase the transition that the objective is designed to reward.

As a construction reference, it helps distinguish offline repair pairs from on-policy episodes and identifies where policy drift enters lineage. As an RLVR reference, it shows how programmatic outcome rewards can supervise a multi-turn episode without becoming process labels. As a test-time-compute reference, it motivates comparing sequential correction and parallel sampling under an equal total sample budget.

Audits should measure no-change edits, wrong-to-right and right-to-wrong transitions, answer-extraction errors, test coverage, checkpoint-selection bias, split overlap, and whether stored traces came from the stated policy version. Because no raw trace artifact was confirmed, these are requirements for a future release rather than claims about an existing public dataset.

对于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 方向，SCoRe 提供了顺序纠错记录的具体 schema：任务和 split 标识、policy checkpoint、训练阶段、第一次作答、纠错指令、第二次作答、抽取答案、r1、r2、progress bonus、KL reference、采样参数和终局 checker 结果。如果只保留第二次回答，就会丢失目标函数真正奖励的跨轮转移。

作为构造参考，它有助于区分离线 repair pair 与 on-policy episode，并指出策略漂移从哪里进入 lineage。作为 RLVR 参考，它展示程序化结果奖励如何监督多轮 episode，而不被误写成过程标签。作为测试时计算参考，它要求在相同总采样预算下比较顺序纠错与并行采样。

审计应检查不修改式纠错、错误到正确和正确到错误的转移、答案抽取错误、测试覆盖、checkpoint 选择偏差、split 重叠，以及存储轨迹是否来自声明的策略版本。由于未确认原始轨迹 artifact 发布，这些是未来发布应满足的要求，而不是对现有公开数据集的声称。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Data object: an on-policy two-turn episode with both attempts, the fixed correction instruction, r1, r2, and the Stage II progress bonus.
  • Stage I improves the second turn while KL-constraining the first turn to the base model; Stage II jointly optimizes both turns.
  • Feedback is binary, answer-level, and programmatic: ground-truth matching for MATH and all-tests-pass for code, not process supervision.
  • The MATH result uses MATH train plus 4,500 former test problems for training and the remaining MATH500 for evaluation.
  • Benchmark gains test the optimization recipe; official code, raw traces, checkpoints, exact split manifest, license, and decontamination remain unconfirmed.

• 数据对象是 on-policy 两轮 episode，包含两次作答、固定纠错指令、r1、r2 和 Stage II progress bonus。
  • Stage I 在用 KL 约束第一轮接近基座模型的同时提高第二轮；Stage II 联合优化两轮。
  • 反馈是二元、答案级、程序化信号：MATH 使用 ground-truth matching，代码使用 all-tests-pass，不是过程监督。
  • MATH 结果使用 MATH train 加 4,500 道原 test 题训练，并在剩余 MATH500 上评估。
  • Benchmark 增益检验优化配方；官方代码、原始轨迹、checkpoint、精确 split manifest、license 和 decontamination 均未确认发布。
